column1: # HUMAN-TIME CATEGORY TAGS — one line per engagement block.
#   REVIEWING   reading that GATES an artifact (freeze ratification, paper review)
#   WATCHING    curiosity — reading along, questions redirecting nothing

# Counterfactual test for the first three: would the artifact exist without this touch?
# Tagging is the maestro's at councils, spot-audited by JYH. An untagged block
# is reported as UNTAGGED and folded into nothing.
